interpretation: Changing only the intrinsic precision isolates a material cost in the native baseline. Installed Chrome compiler options were not measured.
The selected configuration retains safe arithmetic and the original formula. Algebraic rewrites and fast arithmetic are separately labeled experiments.
Historical browser timings differ in output format and trial cadence, and do not isolate browser overhead.
Evidence covers the seeded 100M-marker fixture plus 1,008 boundary inputs; it is not proof for every possible input.
The direct path reads CPU-visible shared Metal output after completion without making a separately owned output copy.
Every integrated trial also ran the original serial oracle outside the optimized timer. All counters and maxima agreed.

reproduction.compile: xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation -framework Metal bench/native-metal-xl/optimized_bench.mm -o tmp/optimized_bench
